title: Instant Pot Quick and Easy Outlaw Chili Beans
description: Beans and lean ground sirloin are cooked in a thick, spicy sauce using the Instant Pot to make tender, quick and easy outlaw chili beans.
ingredients: 1 (29 ounce) can pinto beans, rinsed and drained
2 (4 ounce) cans diced green chiles, undrained
1 tablespoon chile-garlic sauce (such as Huy Fong Foods®), or to taste

steps.text: Turn on a multi-cooker (such as Instant Pot) and the select Saute function. Coat the bottom of the pot with oil.

Cook beef until browned, about 5 minutes. Add onion, celery, and garlic. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is translucent, about 5 minutes. Turn off heat. Add chili beans, pinto beans, tomato sauce, green chiles, chili powder, cider vinegar, chile-garlic sauce, oregano, and cumin. Stir well.
Close and lock the lid. Select high pressure according to manufacturer's instructions; set timer for 10 minutes. Allow 10 to 15 minutes for pressure to build.
Release pressure using the natural-release method according to manufacturer's instructions, 10 to 40 minutes.

video.description: This delicious dinner is ready in under 45 minutes! An Instant Pot makes this cozy chili so easy!
